test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who won the Rugby World Cup 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Africa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **South Africa** has won the Rugby World Cup 2019.
 
• It was the third time South Africa won the World Cup
 
• South Africa won the Rugby World Cup in 2019 after a 32-12 victory over England in Japan.
 
• The South Africa National Rugby Union Team is commonly known as the Springboks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• ​South Africa, on the continent's southern tip, is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean on the west and by the Indian Ocean on the south and east.
 
 
• President: Cyril Ramaphosa (Sept 2022)
 
• Currency: South African rand
 
• Population: 5.93 crores (2020)
 
• Official languages: Afrikaans, English, Xhosa, Zulu, Southern Sotho, etc. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The Rugby World Cup is a men's rugby union tournament contested every four years between the top international teams.
 
 
• Founded: 1987
 
• Next World Cup: Fri, 8 Sept 2023 – Sat, 28 Oct 2023
 
• Number of teams: 20
 
• Holders: South Africa (2019)
